messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Government and Legal Affairs" as it appears in the following examples.
['I am Chief Mr. Ibrahim Lahore the new chairman of ECONOMIC AND FINANCIAL CRIME COMMISSION (FCC).', 'I am the only person with the constitutional power and authority to transfer your contract payment.', 'Now contact my secretary in Cotonou Benin de Republic: NAME:ODOR EMAIL:odobra03@myway.com LEGAL PRACTITIONER & PUBLIC NOTARY REPRESENTATIVE, SUITE 205 MD OMI PLAZA, KAPPA COTONOU BENIN DE REPUBLIC.', 'Recently, the Federal Government of Nigeria directed that all funds not claimed (which has exceeded the stipulated banking period of seven years for such money) should be confiscated to the Federal Government Treasury Because the banking ethics here does not allow such money to stay more than seven years.', 'I seek your consent to present you as the next of kin of the deceased since you are from the same country so that the proceeds of this account valued at Fifteen Million (US$15million) can be paid to you and then you and me can share the money.', 'I ESCAPED WITH MY WIFE AND CHILDREN OUT OF SIERRA- LEON TOGROU-JIRNSSUM, A VILLAGE IN THE NETHERLANDS THROUGH THE AID OF THE UNITEDNATIONS EVACUATION TEAM WHERE WE ARE NOW PRESENTLY RESIDING ON TEMPORARYPOLITICAL ASYLUM.', "According to the Hong Kong Law, under china's foreign and defense affairs, at the expiration of 5 (five) years, such funds will revert to the ownership of the Chinese Government for financing military operations, suchas purchasing of arms and ammunition for the military.", 'We are top officials from the Federal Ministry of Works & Housing (FMH), Federal Ministry of Finance and the presidency, making up the contract review panel(CRP) set up by the Federal Government of Nigeria to review contracts awarded by the past military administration.', 'The government has frozen all the family account and auctioned all our properties.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
